generation.original_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise iterative design refinement.
Input image 1 is the BASE UI screenshot to improve. Input image 2 is a SUPPORTING STYLE REFERENCE for selected vintage reading-journal details only.
Return ONE revised flat desktop UI screenshot with the SAME landscape aspect ratio, frame, layout, overall generous spacing, conversation content, Chinese interface and Japanese text as image 1. It is Shinar, a calm companion for discussing things already read. Preserve the practical three-column application, readable transcript-like discussion, bottom composer and microphone control, navigation and window controls. No new functionality or additional written content.

DESIGN INTENT: preserve the airy, pale, quiet paper quality of image 1, eliminate ALL purple, lavender, lilac, mauve and violet, then introduce a restrained few warm journal details from image 2. This should be more elegant, human, literary and welcoming, with much less decorative density than image 2. A contemporary reading-room conversation with hints of a cherished personal reading journal.

PALETTE CHANGES throughout the entire image, including every icon, text, ribbon and button:
- Main discussion surface: very pale neutral-warm ivory, approximately #F7F3E9. Barely perceptible fine paper fiber, slightly smoother and quieter than image 1, never yellow parchment or brown kraft.
- Sidebar and right-panel substrate: pale oatmeal/linen, approximately #EEE8DC, only a small step darker than main.
- All body and title text: dark walnut/charcoal brown #3F382F, with strong readability. Preserve the elegant Song/Mincho serif feeling and legible Japanese body text of image 1.
- Supporting text warm gray-brown, still legible.
- Sparse accent color: dusty sage/olive #78816B, used at low area and muted saturation.
- Hairlines warm light brass #B9AB91, very thin, no large gilded ornaments.
- Primary "开始语音" microphone button: deep olive-gray #56634F with ivory text. Clear functional icon. Send icon dark olive-gray.
- Active navigation: very pale sage-tinted neutral background, a slim dark olive bookmark-like left marker. History selection warm linen with a subtle sage indicator. No purple or pink undertones.
- User turn: quiet light oat-paper inset, barely darker than chat background, with a very fine warm neutral outline. This must not resemble a large colorful Material card. Partner turns remain directly on pale paper, small olive ink accents/role markers.

BORROW ONLY THESE JOURNAL DETAILS from image 2:
1. In the right context panel, replace the ornate rectangular quotation frame from image 1 with ONE pale cream paper note, its edges just gently organic, containing the SAME Japanese quote. One short translucent beige paper-tape strip at its top, barely noticeable shadow. Add ONE small faded sepia botanical library-style stamp near the lower-right edge of that note. The stamp has a tiny leaf motif and no invented letters or dates. Clean, delicate, not scrapbook clutter.
2. Replace the large open-book illustration in image 1 with a SMALLER refined pen-and-soft-wash illustration inspired by image 2: a sage cloth-bound book with a warm brown ribbon and a tiny botanical sprig. About 35–40% smaller than image 1's illustration, loosely centered beneath the quote, lots of blank space around it. Restrained inkwork. Do not create a photoreal object.
3. The title underline and role labels can have the faint human ink quality of image 2, without introducing crooked geometry to functional controls. Use very small restrained Kai handwriting touches in short note/role labels only. Keep all functional small labels clean.

INVARIANTS:
Keep all legible text from image 1 exactly, especially wordmark "Shinar"; sidebar "材料", "对话", "最近聊天", "雨天与归处", "设置"; header "读完之后，聊一聊", "雨の日の本屋", "示例材料 · 已读完", "结束聊天"; role labels "伙伴" and "你"; messages "あの人は、なぜ戻ったんだと思う？", "帰る場所がほしかったのかもしれません。", "私もそう感じました。", "「帰る場所」って、建物だけではないのかもしれませんね。"; composer "说说你的想法…", "开始语音", "文字与语音，都可以慢慢聊"; right labels "本次语境", "雨の日の本屋", "日语短篇 · 示例"; quote "雨がやむまで、ここにいてもいい。".
Clear interaction hierarchy; voice action and text input are instantly understandable. Text is the visual focus. Large quiet margins. Mature and elegant. No heavy texture, no coffee stains, no tears or burn marks, no extra stickers, no giant botanical ornaments, no scrapbook piles, no extra text, no ambient desk scene, no 3D, no people, no watermarks. Final image is a clean usable UI design with a coherent thin ink icon family.
